description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class `GroupExistsInCenterException` used within the Fineract project to indicate that a group already exists within a center. It extends a base exception class and is part of the `org.apache.fineract.portfolio.group.exception` package.

classes.name: GroupExistsInCenterException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a group already exists within a specific center in the system.

methods.name: GroupExistsInCenterException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with specific center and group identifiers, constructing an appropriate error message.
